content.short: Traceye is a next-gen, powerful data indexing solution for Web3 and blockchain.
content.description: Traceye is a next-generation data indexing solution for Web3 and blockchain. It supports a broad range of L1/L2 blockchains, rollups, and appchains, enabling you to build and deploy custom data indexers optimized for ultrafast indexing, 50% reduced data lag, and high availability with 99.99% uptime, automated sync, and 24/7 monitoring. Traceye also offers value-added features such as webhooks, a BI analytics tool, support for custom entities, and community subgraphs to enable personalization.
